name: Sewing and clothing alterations
summary: How expats find alteration tailors in Singapore for workwear hems, formalwear fittings, and kids’ uniform tweaks — turnaround norms and what to confirm before leaving garments.
body:
Alteration shops densify around malls and heartland rows. Common jobs: trouser hems for tropical crop lengths, waist nips after climate weight shifts, zipper replacements, and school-uniform adjustments.

## Typical work
- Hems, tapers, and waistband fixes
- Jacket sleeve lengths and shoulder reality checks
- Formalwear and wedding-party rush jobs
- Invisible mending vs visible patch honesty
- Simple custom soft furnishings (cushions) at some shops

Dry-cleaners sometimes broker alterations — ask who actually sews.

## How to choose
Prefer shops that pin on your body and write measurements on tickets. Get price and date before leaving officewear. Rush fees before wedding season are normal. Bring matching thread colour references for visible fabrics.

## Practical tip
Wear the shoes you will pair with the hem. Humidity stretch on linen differs from wool — say if the garment will be worn air-con-only vs outdoor walking.
